direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh, overflow hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; rendered scene at least 70% of main; side content condensed inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) for secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions preserved; 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change; animated flow only where real state moves; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene to at least 70% of main and shrink the right evidence zone so stations and jobs gain depth, glow and visible material flow.
Raise side-zone body copy to 16px/24 and keep Source detail rows at least 36px with a clear focus ring.
Add the persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible legend with pattern, marker and text inside the scene zone.
Separate connection readiness for provider identity from the Verified findings evidence task with distinct headings, status and controls.
Enlarge the scene and use bidirectional highlighting between verified facts and RECEIVING, CELL-MILL-1, CELL-MILL-2 and jobs.
Trim side-zone narration to one status sentence so 3 verified, 0 rejected, 3 feasible reads instantly at 16px.
Keep the three Select this path controls explicit that selection opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall.
Make the chosen path glow in the SVG and animate one 240ms route trace, with reduced-motion fallback to a static emerald outline.
Enlarge scene share and align finish and cost metrics at 26px tabular so tradeoffs compare without scanning.
Keep PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL visually dominant so the pending proposal reads as deliberately untracked.
Add depth and state glow distinguishing Ready to begin from After t1 and After t2 without implying tracking has begun.
Ensure Approve The Britt's proposal is the sole primary and at least 44px tall in the 56px action bar.
Label the hatched CELL-MILL-2 preview with plain OFFLINE intent text plus the x marker so preview versus applied state is unambiguous.
Give the 24h to 0h preview a cinematic but reduced-motion-safe transition tied only to the selected machine.
Raise right-zone helper text to 16px/24 while keeping the machine selector at least 36px.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and show no route through it in the refit scene.
Fill the empty reserved findings zone with the distinct investigation evidence task, separate from provider identity readiness.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained directly on its flow path, not only in the bottom option strip.
Match step 3 selection language here: selecting a revised option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall.
Use silver hatching and OFFLINE text on the constrained Split path in both scene and side zone, with the reason in 16px.
Keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED status centred in the action bar so fresh review is unmistakable.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior and 3 PROPOSED visibly coexisting, with replacement tasks clearly awaiting approval and untracked.
Show CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE in the station zone with silver hatching and x marker rather than plain text alone.
Differentiate the approved revised plan glow from the still-proposed task glow so approval state reads at a glance.
Add a completed-state glow and depth progression from Verify ledger to Seal packet to Retain checkpoint as each unlocks.
Raise passphrase helper copy to 16px/24 and keep the input and Verify ledger targets at least 44px.
Make 18 events, 70 parts, 35h accepted and 48h comparison metrics tabular and aligned across the header zone.
Reduce OFFLINE label repetition inside machine icons; keep silver cross-hatching, x marker and one plain OFFLINE text per department for legibility.
Strengthen living emerald material flow along the feasible CNC mills to CNC lathes route with state glow, and stop flow under reduced motion.
Fix clipped department footers such as 5 OFFLINE - 7 RUNNING so counts stay inside their reserved zones at 1366x768.
Enlarge the full-shop cascade visual and its caption type so department flow and OFFLINE states stay legible without zooming.
Add a small cascade legend beside the visual using emerald flow, silver hatching, x marker and OFFLINE text.
Tighten the hero to cascade gap so the required order moves faster from pitch and Live demo link to proof.
